Modeling Approach: Exact decomposition, weights with the precision of the data. Bound chain in the same run: degree, two-line bound, SAT certificates
Workflow: Parallel run (6 threads): solution chain and bound chain in one run, stopping when they meet; final solution found by: beam search over zeroing steps
Hardware Specifications: Apple MacBook Pro, M4 Pro (8 performance + 4 efficiency cores), 24 GB RAM
Remarks: Exact decomposition (no tolerance), with weights of the precision of the data (integers at the given scale). A run: 60 s per instance; without a proof of optimality, a second round of 600 s that starts from scratch; the result of the run is the shorter decomposition of the two rounds. Best Objective Value: the shortest decomposition over the runs. Optimality Bound: the largest lower bound over the runs that holds for real weights. Total Runtime: the time of the whole run (both rounds). CPU Runtime: the measured CPU time of all threads in both rounds, mean over the runs with the seeds 1 to 4 (the CPU time of the run with seed 0 was not measured).
